## Project identity

**Name:** spring-saas-support-ai
**Tagline:** Open-source AI customer support platform for SMBs — white-label chatbot, embeddable in 5 minutes.
**Type:** Full-stack monorepo (Spring Boot API + minimal React admin + vanilla JS widget)
**Team size:** 1 (solo)
**Stage:** Active development — Milestone 2 complete, Milestone 3 (AI Chat) in progress
**Goal:** Portfolio/job hunting (primary) + passive income (secondary)

---

## Tech stack

**Language:** Java 21 (records, sealed interfaces, pattern matching)
**Framework:** Spring Boot 3.3
**Build tool:** Maven
**Test framework:** JUnit 5 + Testcontainers (real DB — no H2)
**Package manager:** Maven
**AI framework:** Spring AI 1.1+
**Primary LLM:** Anthropic Claude (claude-3-5-sonnet / claude-3-haiku)
**Embeddings:** OpenAI text-embedding-3-small
**DB:** PostgreSQL 16 + PgVector extension
**Migrations:** Flyway
**Auth:** JJWT (JWT, HS256)
**Payment:** Stripe Java SDK
**Email:** Resend (SMTP fallback)
**Storage:** MinIO (document uploads)
**Observability:** Micrometer + Prometheus
**Containers:** Docker Compose (local dev + test)

## Architecture overview

**Style:** Modular monolith — domain packages with internal slice architecture

**Package structure:**
```
com.leonardtrinh.supportsaas
├── auth/           # JWT, signup, login, refresh, password reset
├── tenant/         # TenantContext, Hibernate filter, Business entity
├── member/         # Member, Invitation, role management
├── invitation/     # Invitation flows
├── knowledgebase/  # KB CRUD
├── document/       # Upload, parse, chunk, embed pipeline
│   ├── ingestion/  # Async ingestion pipeline
│   ├── chunk/      # Chunking logic
│   └── search/     # Hybrid vector + full-text search
├── chatbot/        # Chatbot settings, Widget config
├── chat/           # Streaming SSE, conversation, message
├── billing/        # Stripe, Subscription, Plan, UsageRecord
├── storage/        # MinIO integration
├── email/          # Email sending
├── audit/          # Audit log
├── admin/          # Super-admin endpoints
├── common/         # Base entities, ApiResponse envelope, GlobalExceptionHandler
└── config/         # Security, AsyncConfig, OpenAPI, CORS
```

**Slice pattern per package:** `Controller → Service → Repository → Entity`

**Entry point:** `src/main/java/com/leonardtrinh/supportsaas/SupportSaasApplication.java`

**External dependencies:**
- PostgreSQL 16 + PgVector — primary DB + vector store (`SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL`)
- Flyway — schema migrations (auto-runs on startup)
- Anthropic Claude — chat completions (`SPRING_AI_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`)
- OpenAI — embeddings only (`SPRING_AI_OPENAI_API_KEY`)
- Stripe — subscription billing (`STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`)
- Resend — transactional email (`RESEND_API_KEY`)
- MinIO — document object storage (`MINIO_ENDPOINT`)

## Key conventions

**Code style:** IDE-only (no Checkstyle/Spotless configured)
**Branch strategy:** `feature/*` → `develop` → `master`
**Commit format:** Conventional commits (`feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `test`, `docs`, `chore`)
**Test coverage target:** 80% service layer minimum, 100% tenant isolation paths
**DTOs:** Java 21 records — never Lombok
**Error handling:** Typed exceptions → `GlobalExceptionHandler` → `ProblemDetail` (RFC 7807)
**Null safety:** Never return `null` — use `Optional<T>` or throw

**API response envelope:**
```java
record ApiResponse<T>(boolean success, T data, String error) {
    static <T> ApiResponse<T> ok(T data) { return new ApiResponse<>(true, data, null); }
    static <T> ApiResponse<T> fail(String error) { return new ApiResponse<>(false, null, error); }
}
```

## What Claude should know before touching code

**No-touch zones:**
- `target/` — Maven build output, never edit manually
- `.env` — secrets file, never commit or modify manually
- `src/main/resources/db/migration/V*.sql` — applied Flyway migrations, **NEVER modify once applied**, only add new versioned files

**Test isolation requires:**
- Docker Compose must be running before integration tests (`docker-compose up -d`)
- `SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=test` env var set
- Some tests need seed data — check test resource files
- Test classes: `{Name}Test` (unit), `{Name}IT` (integration)

**Sensitive areas (extra care + security review before merge):**
- `auth/` — JWT filter chain, token issuance, `JwtAuthFilter` sets/clears `TenantContext`
- `tenant/` — Hibernate filter, `TenantContext` ThreadLocal — see multi-tenancy rules below
- `document/ingestion/` — async pipeline, requires `@Async("taskExecutor")` for tenant propagation

**Build order:** Standard Maven — `mvn clean package -DskipTests` (no codegen step)

## Multi-Tenancy — CRITICAL SAFETY RULES

Every business entity MUST extend `TenantEntity`. Hibernate auto-applies `WHERE business_id = :tenantId`.

```java
// ALWAYS this pattern — NEVER skip the finally block
try {
    TenantContext.setTenantId(tenantId);
    filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
} finally {
    TenantContext.clear();  // thread pool reuse — leak = data breach
}
```

1. Every business table **MUST** have `business_id` column — enforced by Hibernate filter
2. `TenantContext.clear()` **MUST** be in a `finally` block — no exceptions
3. `@Async` methods **MUST** use `@Async("taskExecutor")` — never bare `@Async`
4. `disableFilter` is **ONLY** allowed in `Admin*` repository classes
5. `spring.threads.virtual.enabled=false` — virtual threads break ThreadLocal scoping
6. Service **MUST** call `TenantContext.getTenantId()` when creating entities — filter does NOT auto-set `business_id` on save

## Commands

```bash
# Build
mvn clean package -DskipTests

# Test
mvn test                  # unit tests
mvn verify                # includes integration tests (requires Docker Compose up)
mvn test -Dtest=TenantIsolationIT   # critical isolation test

# Run locally
docker-compose up -d      # start postgres + minio + mailhog
mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=dev

# Database
mvn flyway:migrate
mvn flyway:info
```

---

## What NOT to do

- No Lombok — use Java 21 records
- No Kafka/RabbitMQ — use `@Async` + `ThreadPoolTaskExecutor`
- No microservices — monolith first
- No ElasticSearch — PgVector + PG full-text is enough
- No multiple databases — one PostgreSQL for everything
- No H2 for tests — Testcontainers only
- No scope creep (mobile, voice, multi-language UI, multiple LLMs)
- No bypassing Hibernate tenant filter
- No bare `@Async` — always `@Async("taskExecutor")`
